notes.title: Demo with 110 levels available
notes.content:
In preparation for Steam Next Fest we have released our demo for SPiNG. Or SP!NG if you prefer it's original non web search friendly name :)

If you enjoy the demo please wishlist the game, tell a friend about it and say hi to your mum for us.

As the game is finished and we have over 1000 hand crafted levels how much should we have put into the demo? We opted for the more is better approach so you'll have over 100 levels to play through. is that too much? you tell us. We're confident the game is addictive enough you'll not want to stop!  

This is 110 levels which represents < 10% of the game and gives a good sample of what to expect. Some easy levels, some hard and the variety of modes. This should take someone 1-2 hrs to complete and a little longer if you're going to 3 star every level.

[b]There is also 3/7 themes to unlock.[/b]

[b]Your save game carries across to the full game also.[/b]

[b]What's included:[/b]

[list]
[*] Classic: 3/16 chapters: 55 / 288 levels
[*] Rush: 1/20 chapters: 18  / 360 levels
[*] One Chance 1/3 chapters: 18 / 54 levels
[*] Lost Levels: 1/17 chapters: 18 / 301 levels
[*] Daily Race: 1/3 Daily Modes
[*] Zen mode: Just chill in this area
[/list]

[b]What's locked in the demo:[/b]

[list]
[*] All the remaining chapters/levels from above 
[*] +
[*] The Lab: 18 levels
[*] One Life: How long can you last without dying and going through random levels
[*] Hyper: classic: 288 levels at a faster pace
[*] Play Perfect: 126 Levels that require precision
[*] Endless: This is our score chasing mode using procedural levels
[*] Hyper: Lab: 18 levels
[/list]


Phew! that's a lot of stuff. Enjoy!   We can consider this demo also a public beta test so if you encounter any issues let us know so we can fix them before release in main game!
